item.dc:creator: Tamara Kater
item.description:
Deadline Reminder: MusicNL’s Touring and Professional Development Program operates on a monthly, juried intake cycle. The current funding round closes Tuesday, March 31, and applicants are notified of results approximately three weeks after the deadline. Submit your application today! Learn more about our funding programs here: musicnl.ca/funding.
